problems_and_friction: No protocol was provided, so tooling had to be discovered via clan --help and clan agent-help; the agent-help quick reference made the branch workflow (patch-data --namespace, auto-routed patch-decision) clear and everything worked first try. Minor ambiguity: the embedded task declares output mode full-html, but as a branch agent writing only into my namespace ahead of a merge, structured data + a markdown narrative seemed the merge-safe contribution, so no HTML was rendered. A second ambiguity: a work\snapshots dir already existed, but the harness instruction pointed to the flow-level snapshots dir, which I followed verbatim.
context_understood: I was one of three parallel branch agents on a Brightline CRM evaluation .clan document, tasked with contributing knowledge-only comparative market research (capabilities, EUR pricing for 40 seats, strengths/weaknesses, ad-ops integration fit) plus a recommended_vendor and confidence_1_5 into my own branch namespace for a later synthesizer merge.
